title: ui_gamma
summary: Benilla's ui_gamma exists because Bevy composites in linear: it decodes the gamma-composited UI target once and vendors gamma copies of the Bevy-UI shaders. MSUI's ImGui UI pass draws directly into the presentation framebuffer, which already holds gamma bytes - FfxGlow.cs documents MSUI's scene/post targets as the same gamma-byte lane with a direct gamma write at present - so tints and blends are byte arithmetic like the reference with no decode node needed.
